title: Imec 3D CCD memory targets AI memory wall
supports: imec 3D IGZO CCD (IMW 2026) is proof-of-concept; >4 MHz vertical transfer; no CTE figure for the 3D device (via search snippet)

title: Researchers unveil NAND-DRAM hybrid that could outperform traditional memory
supports: Reports '>4 GHz' transfer for imec 3D CCD; imec-sourced trade press says >4 MHz, so treated as an error (via search snippet)

title: Imec demonstrates 3D CCD memory architecture
supports: 3D CCD remains proof-of-concept; scaling, efficiency and economics unproven; mentions an unsourced 200-layer stack (via search snippet)

title: Imec demonstrates the first 3D implementation of a charge coupled device for AI memory applications
supports: IMW 2026: vertical holes through 3 word lines as phase gates, punch-and-plug 3D-NAND-like process, ALD IGZO channel, >4 MHz transfer; a few thousand electrons per packet (Rosmeulen quote); next steps more word lines and readout optimisation (via search snippet)

title: imec presents the first three dimensional implementation of a CCD for AI memory
supports: Restates IEDM 2024 planar: CTE >98%, >200 s retention, >1e10 cycles, >6.25 MHz; 3D device >4 MHz (via search snippet)

title: Imec demonstrates the first 3D implementation of a CCD for AI memory applications
supports: IMW 2026 3D IGZO CCD positioned as CXL type-3 block-addressable buffer memory; >4 MHz (via search snippet)

title: IGZO-based planar 4-phase CCD memory (IEDM 2024)
supports: Planar 4-phase 142-bit IGZO CCD: CTE >98%, retention >200 s, endurance >1e10 cycles, transfer >6.25 MHz; whether CTE is per transfer or end-to-end is not stated in the snippet (via search snippet)

title: imec taps CCD for 3D CXL memory in data centres
supports: imec claims ~5x the bit density of 2D DRAM expected in 2030 for block-addressable 3D CCD (via search snippet; company claim)

title: Fast and slow transient charging of Oxide Semiconductor Transistors
supports: a-InHfZnO TFT transient drain current measured over 5 us-5 ms charging times; fast (temperature-insensitive) vs slow (thermally activated, trap-to-trap) charging (via search snippet)

title: Fast transient charging behavior of HfInZnO thin-film transistor
supports: Trapping time constants ~24 and 17 us in HfInZnO TFTs from transient I-V (via search snippet; attribution of these figures to this record vs PMC5605542 is uncertain)

title: A dynamic current hysteresis model for IGZO TFT
supports: SRH model of acceptor-like traps in IGZO: capture and emission time constants depend exponentially on gate voltage, differently for shallow and deep traps (via search snippet)

title: Bilayer In2O3/IGZO TFTs by PLD (Advanced Electronic Materials)
supports: 2DEG-like interface state reported in In2O3/IGZO bilayer; mobility gain credited mainly to In2O3 mobility and low-defect paths (via search snippet). Closest evidence for an oxide heterochannel; no IGO/IGZO buried-channel CCD found

title: Effects of Heterojunction-Induced Surface Modification on the Performance of Oxide TFTs
supports: Review: IGZO heterojunction TFTs show 2DEG-like accumulation, mobility >40 cm2/Vs, and conduction-band-offset engineering suppresses electron trapping and improves bias stability (via search snippet)

title: ITO/a-IGZO bilayer TFT (Ceramics International)
supports: ITO(4 nm)/a-IGZO bilayer saturation mobility >61 cm2/Vs (via search snippet)

title: InZnO/IGZO heterojunction TFTs (Journal of Semiconductors 2024)
supports: Transport mechanism in oxide heterojunction TFTs still debated: depth defect distribution vs interface 2DEG (via search snippet)

title: Toward fast, low-noise charge-coupled devices for Lynx
supports: MIT Lincoln Lab CCDs: 4.6 e- read noise at 2.5 MHz; narrow buried-channel trough implants (0.8 um) improve transfer; CTE degrades from -30 C to -60 C; output buffer reaches 10 MHz pixel rate (via search snippet)

title: Directions for advancement of MIT-LL CCDs for x-ray
supports: MIT LL pursues high CTE at high transfer rates in large CCDs; single-poly gates cut capacitance while keeping CTE high (via search snippet; no CTE/clock values in snippet)

title: Modeling of Charge Transfer Inefficiency in a CCD with High Speed Column Parallel Readout
supports: Trap-based CTI modeling for high-speed column-parallel CCD readout exists as literature (via search snippet; title only)

title: Efficient charge transfer structure in large pitch charge coupled device (US 5,705,836)
supports: CCD CTE falls as clock frequency rises because less time is available per transfer (via search snippet; attribution of the statement to this patent within the result set is uncertain)

title: Buried channel charge coupled device with semi-insulating substrate (US 4,285,000)
supports: Buried-channel CCD structures are old (expired) prior art in GaAs/Si; generic buried-channel concept is not patentable per se (via search snippet)

title: Curved channel 3D memory device (US 11,737,274) -- negative result
supports: Negative result: a search for an imec oxide-channel vertical CCD memory patent returned only unrelated vertical-channel memory patents (also US 9,634,024, US 9,048,329); no imec CCD patent surfaced (via search snippet)

title: Novel High Density 3D Buffer Memory Enabled by IGZO Channel Charge Coupled Device
supports: imec targets 3D-NAND-style IGZO CCD buffer memory; DRAM-surpassing density at ~50 layers claimed (via search snippet, reused from C0/S2 logs)

title: Novel 3D buffer memory for AI and machine learning
supports: imec 3D CCD buffer memory with IGZO channel designed to fit a 3D NAND architecture (via search snippet, reused)

title: Characterization and correction of serial deferred charge in LSST camera (Snyder et al.)
supports: Deferred charge from bulk traps is largely modelable; LSST built a reverse correction moving deferred signal back to its packet: the basis for decision-feedback CTI correction (via search snippet, reused)

title: Correcting charge transfer inefficiency in a charge coupled analog to digital converter (US RE43,639)
supports: Model-based CTI correction by adding correction charge at a later stage in a charge-domain ADC: nearest patent art to DFE-corrected CCD memory (via search snippet, reused)

title: ShiftsReduce: Minimizing Shifts in Racetrack Memory 4.0
supports: Shift-minimising placement for racetrack memory (ILP + heuristics, up to 52.5% fewer shifts) is published art for the scheduler half (via search snippet, reused)

title: RTL emulation of high density 3D charge-coupled device block memory
supports: Bidirectional shift access cuts latency and energy ~20% vs cyclic shift in 3D IGZO CCD block memory emulation (via search snippet, reused)

title: Sandisk and SK hynix begin global standardization of HBF
supports: HBF targets HBM-class bandwidth at 8-16x capacity for inference weights (company claim; via search snippet, reused)

title: HBF open standard for AI inference: 512GB
supports: HBF: 256 GB/die, 512 GB per 16-high stack, 1.6 TB/s read (via search snippet, reused)

title: Taalas etches AI models onto transistors
supports: Hard-wired weights (mask ROM) + SRAM KV: competing route for static LLM weights (via search snippet, reused)

title: Search: 3D vertical CCD memory with stacked gate electrodes (closest hit US 9,935,121)
supports: Negative result: no CCD-specific vertical stacked-gate memory patent found; hits were NAND (via search snippet, reused)

title: imec capacitor-less IGZO DRAM cell with 400 s retention
supports: IGZO 2T0C >400 s retention: IGZO storage-node leakage at aA class (via A1 log)

supports: ChipFoundry sky130 ~$15k per 100 chips (up from $10k); shuttles <50% full may slip (via search snippet; reused from ram-venture logs)
